title: Research: certify PR #2979's V45 final-word controls fail the complete packing budget
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The local V45 guide comparison does not by itself price its controls on PR #2979's final owner allocation. This independent audit fixes the final scalar gates, partner frames, later extraction/rewrite stages and cleanup, then restores any subset of endpoints 249/251/265/267 from their shared rank-seven space to their own parent rank-eight endpoints.

All 15 nonempty widening controls fail the source complex saving even with arbitrary fractional repacking in the fixed capacity model. In particular, retaining only helper249 lowered gives a certified complete moment **at least 1.000005090277**, above the budget of 1. The actual coordinated final word passes at that same exact saving, `1729033982646513517717 / 10^24`. No root search or extra endpoint digits are contributed.

The new package independently recounts both providers and checks all 271,728 placements and 149,184 bins. The complete baseline profile is `{1:1645680,2:470196,3:159468,4:71928,5:13716,8:5328,48:28190}`, with rank mass 4,816,512. Every V45 occurrence is in a saturated bin. The single-retained-endpoint control overfills 1,938 bins by 1,998 width units; at least 15,354 whole-helper width units must leave those source bins. This deletion lower bound does not price or construct a legal relocation.

The stronger obstruction uses a written packing-dual argument, independently enumerates all 2,551 admissible patterns, and certifies its inequalities with integer-square-root tariff enclosures. Summing every bin and local-child tariff gives the complete recursive lower bound. The nominal stock remains `66,304 + 408 + 8 + 91 + 2 = 66,813`; both providers retain 5,207 cleanup operations and all 91 private names.

**Status:** finite certificate and scoped obstruction, author-checked with an implementation independent of the predecessor's code. These are final-word controls, explicitly retaining stages two and three, not reconstructions of the original stage-one experiment. Native/dirty-state cleanup, physical backing and movement, precision/prefix/tape, full supplier caps, outer release and all-size/compiler obligations remain open. The complex-budget rejection suffices for these controls; no bit-side cap, new supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is asserted.

Success requires a passing baseline, exact control failures and semantic negative controls. The optimistic budget grants free compaction and then arbitrary fractional repacking; additional physical costs cannot rescue a strict recursive-budget failure. At final check the complete-paginated cache covered 253 open PRs at `2026-10-17T17:49:11.608413+00:00` and 2,017 discussion records at `2026-10-17T17:52:04.322463+00:00`. Merged package notes and the review ledger were also inspected. The cache cannot establish novelty or cover later changes. Canonical main was fetched again at the `2026-10-17T17:57:07.027080+00:00` checkpoint: still the base above, no changed paths, priority revision 6 unchanged; frozen inputs were preserved. Main was still at this base at `2026-10-17T18:45:22Z`.

## Validation

Python 3.12.3, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py
python3 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-final-fill-controls
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rank7-final-fill-controls
```

Observed results:

```text
PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY
PASS_RANK7_FINAL_FILL_CONTROLS cases=16 rejected_controls=15 roles=271728 bins=149184 packing_patterns=2551
Ran 13 tests ... OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/rank7-final-fill-controls outcome=completed
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES ... files=22 ...
```

The thirteen behavioral groups include an explicit-point-set GF(2) oracle, exact algebraic square/cube checks of the tariff enclosure, a separate pattern enumerator, all-subset axis-spill counts, and exhaustive deletion subsets for the single-retained-endpoint control. Mutations reject missing/duplicate roles, physical-family conflicts, unavailable windows, missing bins, overlapping/noncompact slices, invalid terminal/private inventories, unpaid children, altered source bindings, an infeasible dual and an omitted pattern. An optimized Git-free export passes; a changed source byte fails before decoding. All acceptance conditions survive `-O`.

The mathematical implication comes from summing the certified dual inequalities, not from finite tests alone. Full rational bounds and deterministic witness digests are in RESULT.json. `verify.py --witnesses OUTPUT.json` can exclusively write every capacity witness. Working/package/input bytes match all 22 committed files; staged whitespace checks and reverse-application checking of the exported patch pass.

No Lean, Docker, full selected cold replay, native-program regeneration, outer release or hosted CI was run. Ruff is unavailable in this environment; no lint pass is claimed. The package replay does not establish complete multiplication-theorem admission.

## Open next questions

See the package README's "Open next questions" section and `TASK.json`. The smallest useful admission follow-up is to join the exact final fill to the existing native/private evidence, choose one still-unbound consumer cost, and either close it or give an exact obstruction. The current audit leaves native closure, dirty restoration, backing/movement, precision/tape and outer/all-size implications open.

A matched complete comparison of the *original* stage-one parent/joint/single words would need separately legal allocations and all charges; these final-word controls do not supply it. That would require a distinct bounded construction budget and family decision. No additional lowering census is proposed here.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

Add coverage pointers for PR #2993/#3014/#3038 and distinguish local-guide, final-allocation and native-private obligations in that field.
